PFA Sirohi

PFA Sirohi report of ONE TREE ONE GIRL INITIATIVE

5000 Trees will be planted in this initiative.

PFA and District Administration will monitor the whole process of planting tree in sirohi district.

Led by visionary PFA secretary Amit Deol ,PFA sirohi is now celebrating the birth of girls by planting a tree- linking environmentalism and gender activism in what experts are calling “ECO-FEMINISM”. This initiative was started with the help of Surendra Kumar Solanki, IAS D.M. Sirohi, Ankita Rajpurohit RAS, Assistant Director, Women Development Department, Dr. Darshan Grover , C.M.O GOVT. Hospital Sirohi, Dr. Usha Chouhan, Govt. Ladies Hospital, Sirohi, In Programme Social Worker Ramesh Singhvi , Raghunath P. Mali, Rajesh Jain, Vinod Haran, Ganpat Singh Deora, Ankur Rawal, Bhik Singh Bhati Forest department, Education Departrment, Health Department, Panchayati Raj Dept. and other NGOS Groups such as Smt. Puribai Punmaji Chairtable Trust, Mohanlal Rataji Mali Raipuriya ,Late Kantaben Pukhraj P. Shah, Barloot, Lalitkumar Pukhrajji Shah , Peshua, Shree Adi Jin Yuwak Charitable Trust , Mumbai, Punyodaya Foundation Posaliya, Kshtriya Ganchi Samal Yuwak Sanghatan, Sirohi, Jhora Magra Jain Mitra Mandal, Jawal , Shri Hanumant Singh Solanki . Goily , Shree Gyan Raman Foundation , Sirohi were present and financially helped the whole initiative.
